## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] I tested any changed FFmpeg command on at least one representative file.
- [ ] I did not add telemetry, remote upload, or hidden network behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.

## Security / privacy impact

Describe any change to subprocess execution, file handling, metadata handling, or dependencies.
